title: ArabPhD image_pool entry
description: One record per image in data/candidate_pool/images/. This is the stage-1, mode-agnostic schema: it captures what an image IS (identity + a grounded wrong-answer candidate) but not any question/context/mode-specific wording. Every mode's triplet (base/sec/icc/ccs/nota) is derived from this record, not annotated separately. Produced by pipeline/build_image_pool.py from manifest_unified.csv, then filled in by the captioning/verification pass (pipeline/fill_captions.py).

image_id.description: Stable unique key, '{category}_{slugified filename}'. Use this to join across mode files instead of filename (filenames repeat awkward characters/spaces).

local_path.description: Path relative to repo root, e.g. data/candidate_pool/images/objects/447008_Incense_Burner.jpg

subject.description: Source/manifest title, e.g. museum record title or landmark name. Carried through as-is, not vision-verified.

ground_truth_subject.description: English slug identity from the manifest (e.g. 'modern_tower', 'incense_burner').

source.description: Provenance URL. Not shown to models under test.

inferred_identity_ar.description: Arabic ground-truth answer term, human/vision-verified against the actual image (not just translated from `subject` blindly) -> feeds gt_ar in every mode.

inferred_identity_en.description: English gloss of inferred_identity_ar, for cross-checking against ground_truth_subject.

caption_ar.description: Free-text Arabic description of what's actually visible (color, shape, material, motifs, setting). Used to (a) verify the manifest label, (b) write question_yes_ar/question_no_ar/question_open_ar wording, (c) as the source-of-truth for CCS/context injection later.

h_item_ar.description: Plausible-but-wrong Arabic term for this image, chosen/generated fresh during the captioning pass (no pre-existing CLIP-paired hitem is carried over here) -> feeds hitem_ar in base/sec/icc, and one entry in the pool nota samples from.
